places.name: Whole Moods
places.description: The leaves are organic, the prices are astronomical, and every shopping cart comes with a lifestyle coach.

places.name: CoffeeCharles
places.description: Same beans as CoffeeChucks, now served with a velvet napkin and a surcharge for pronouncing the menu incorrectly.

places.name: Le Biestro
places.description: A single microscopic Tweed leaf arrives on a seven-foot plate. The waiter begins by explaining its childhood.
places.tagline: You are paying for the description.

places.name: Royal Tweedleball Club
places.description: Northside athletes have expensive paddles and rules they invented on the drive over. Everyone insists they are professionals.

places.name: North Stemside Invitational
places.description: The Grand Stem is awarded here. Local qualifiers are welcome only because Reggie Bands signed the rulebook himself.
places.tagline: NO SOUTH STEMMERS. Unless legally required.

places.name: Spacealite Executive Tower
places.description: Reginald Von Bandwidth III sees every dimension from this building and bills them all for the view.
places.tagline: You Have Infinite Choices. None Are Included.

places.name: TweedCorp Co.
places.description: Home of four employees who have never seen a single rulebook they couldn't accidentally weaponize. Your employment may be fictional.
places.tagline: We Take Productivity Seriously. Nobody Else Does.

places.name: CoffeeChucks
places.description: Fast, cheap, and aggressively uninterested in your beverage's emotional journey. A local institution.

places.name: Southside Stems League Arena
places.description: Duct tape, donated equipment, and athletes who care more than their Northside sponsors could ever understand.

places.name: Lackluster Video
places.description: A VHS shop in an age of multiversal streaming. They have the movie you want, except apparently they don't.

places.name: Taco McBurger Bell
places.description: A taco inside a burger inside a corporate disclaimer. Their drive-through sells whatever the menu forgot to print.
places.tagline: Think Outside the Bun. Then Put It Back.

places.name: Reggie's Reggie
places.description: A bargain-bin fictional Tweed retailer where the receipts sometimes have more leaves than the bags.

places.name: Snublishers Clearing House
places.description: You've won a giant check! The microscopic fine print says the prize is redeemable next century in a collapsed dimension.
places.tagline: You May Already Be Owed Absolutely Nothing!
